links.name: Synthetic users console
links.note: The simulator's page (ADR 0044): the animals, load mode, their history, what the load costs. It asks for the control token, FINUANCE_SIM_CONTROL_TOKEN in .env.lab; make sim-up prints the address with it.

links.name: Lab resources
links.note: CPU, memory and disk of every container, the database's work and the API's answers, with the animals' actions over them. Grafana of the lab, no sign-in.

links.name: Simulator
links.note: What the animals do, their errors and the latency they see.
